title: Revealment under equal query probabilities
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite input alphabet with probability law $\pi$, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree with finite nonempty seed space on $n>0$ coordinates. Suppose every coordinate has the same query probability under independent inputs of law $\pi$. Then the revealment of $T$ equals its average number of queries divided by $n$.
hypotheses_covered: Randomized decision tree with finite nonempty seed space and seed law
